records.subject: You're in -- let's get Clearwater Partners set up
records.body:
Hi Leo,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Clearwater Partners* just joined on the team plan!

decisions.rationale: First project created day 0 and 1 invite sent (facts) show early intent, but no key milestone in 6 days and zero replies to onboarding outreach [email:b3027c93], no tickets. Team plan signals real budget/intent; 8 days remain. Moderate-low unaided odds.

draft.subject: Getting Clearwater's first tasks moving in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

You've got your first project up in Wrenfield and an invite out to a teammate, which is a good start. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next step is usually getting real work into that project so your team sees the value straight away.

If it's useful, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week and help you map Clearwater Partners' current workflow into projects and tasks. Just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around you.

Best,
Chidi
